title: Cult city set: the lodge town, City 1-3, in fixed faction colours

recipes.notes: Bead pulp_wars-mch9.16 (Cultists ART4, docs/art/factions/CULT.md, Cities): City 1 in the calm settlement class, as the Martian, Ice Folk, Dwarf and Candy direction cities. The roofs are asked for as bright saturated royal blue, which the cult-lodge accent turns into the lodge's indigo.

recipes.notes: cult-city-1-a is the right materials (cream weatherboard, a blue roof, the brass dome and telescope, a green window and lamp) but its three gables are plain, with none of the bent hood points the buildings have, and it stands on a stone slab. The addendum asks for the curled points and no slab.
recipes.promptAddendum: Every roof ends in a tall point that curls over like the tip of a wizard hat. No base and no slab under the walls.

recipes.notes: Bead pulp_wars-mch9.16: City 1 with generate-image-v2 in the class of the Cult buildings (calm-feature, the light stated), sixteen candidates at the master canvas. The two Pixen samples of City 1 (cult-city-1-a, cult-city-1-b) had plain gables on a slab or dark timber frames and straight spires 84 x 91 px, too big for the 80 x 80 canvas; the Sawmill sample of this class drew the curled hood-tip roof in ten of sixteen.

Bead pulp_wars-mch9.16: City 2 with generate-image-v2 in the class of the Cult buildings (calm-feature, the light stated), sixteen candidates at the master canvas. The two Pixen samples of City 1 (cult-city-1-a, cult-city-1-b) had plain gables on a slab or dark timber frames and straight spires 84 x 91 px, too big for the 80 x 80 canvas; the Sawmill sample of this class drew the curled hood-tip roof in ten of sixteen.

Bead pulp_wars-mch9.16: City 3 with generate-image-v2 in the class of the Cult buildings (calm-feature, the light stated), sixteen candidates at the master canvas. The two Pixen samples of City 1 (cult-city-1-a, cult-city-1-b) had plain gables on a slab or dark timber frames and straight spires 84 x 91 px, too big for the 80 x 80 canvas; the Sawmill sample of this class drew the curled hood-tip roof in ten of sixteen.

cult-city-2-v is the right town (candidate 0: the observatory tower, the hall with a curled roof, the houses, the wall and gate) but every candidate is 83 to 87 px wide on the 88 px canvas, as wide as City 3 (86 px) and far from City 1 (62 px); the other factions' City 2 is 72 to 74 px. The asset's subject line is now CITY:CULT:2/SMALL, which asks for a town two thirds of the image wide (the description limit leaves no room for an addendum).

cult-city-1-v, candidate 4, has every part (the hall between two houses, three curled roofs, the dome and telescope, a green window) but its left-facing walls are the shaded ones: the light measure (scripts/art/lighting-qa.ts) reads it as lit from the right, and so do ten of the sixteen; the six lit from the left have the curl or the dome, never both. The asset's subject line is now CITY:CULT:1/LIT, which says which walls are pale.
